name: Kelsey Taylor
source:
Kelsey Taylor, better known as Swallow (and not for what you're thinking), does what she wants when she wants to and go wherever she wants when she wants. A problem child of sorts, but also responsible enough to (barely) pass her classes.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/move-chains-plot-70773805]Patreon[/url]]
